WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey, min(toYear(DateKey)) AS first_year
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
cohort_2007 AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey FROM first_purchase WHERE first_year = 2007
),
returned_2008 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s
    INNER JOIN cohort_2007 c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2008
),
returned_2009 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s
    INNER JOIN returned_2008 r ON s.CustomerKey = r.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2009
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count() FROM cohort_2007) AS first_bought_2007,
    (SELECT count() FROM returned_2008) AS returned_in_2008,
    (SELECT count() FROM returned_2009) AS returned_again_in_2009;
